title: Safe FFI Functions
goal: Declare C functions without preconditions as safe in an extern block.
hints: Functions like `abs` take simple integers and cannot cause undefined behavior.
Marking the function `safe` allows calling it without an `unsafe` block.
explanation: External C functions that cannot cause undefined behavior can be marked `safe` in `unsafe extern` blocks. Calling a `safe` FFI function does not require an `unsafe` block at the call site. Declaring it `unsafe` causes `E0133` when called safely.
